2609.30059.title: KernelOPT: Dispatch-Aware Agentic Search for GPU Kernel Optimization
2609.30059.paper_summary: Deep learning inference and training performance depends critically on GPU kernel efficiency. Modern compilers such as PyTorch Inductor automatically generate GPU kernels from high-level model code, but frequently underperform expert-written implementations by wide margins. Recent LLM-assisted kernel optimizers can close this gap for standalone kernels, yet treat compiled models as black boxes, generally optimizing individual standalone kernels without respecting the compiler's structural decisions or verifying the model end-to-end. We present KernelOPT, a multi-agent system that treats compiled models as structured artifacts. It preserves vendor library calls (cuBLAS, cuDNN) and exclusively targets generated Triton sub-kernels using five profiling-guided LLM agents. A four-gate verification cascade of static validation, multi-seed correctness, model-level float64-fallback verification, and performance gating filters candidates during optimization and verifies the re-stitched model end-to-end. If no candidate passes all four gates, the system preserves the compiler baseline. The system accepts PyTorch nn.Modules, standalone Triton kernels, and Helion kernels. Evaluated on 250 KernelBench problems, KernelOPT achieves geometric mean speedups over \texttt{torch.compile} of 1.40$\times$ (Level 1: 51/100), 1.15$\times$ (Level 2: 31/100), and 1.07$\times$ (Level 3: 12/50) across all problems.
2609.30059.paper_summary_zh: 深度學習推理和訓練性能在很大程度上依賴於 GPU 核心的效率。現代編譯器如 PyTorch Inductor 自動從高階模型代碼生成 GPU 核心，但經常在性能上遠遠落後於專家編寫的實現。最近的 LLM 輔助核心優化器可以縮小獨立核心的差距，但將編譯模型視為黑箱，通常優化單個獨立核心，而不考慮編譯器的結構決策或驗證模型的端到端。 我們提出了 KernelOPT，一個將編譯模型視為結構化工件的多代理系統。它保留供應商庫調用（cuBLAS、cuDNN），並專門針對生成的 Triton 子核心，使用五個基於分析的 LLM 代理。四級驗證級聯包括靜態驗證、多種種子正確性、模型級 float64 回退驗證和性能閘，過濾優化過程中的候選者並驗證重新拼接的模型的端到端。如果沒有候選者通過所有四個閘，系統將保留編譯器基線。該系統接受 PyTorch nn.Modules、獨立 Triton 核心和 Helion 核心。在 250 個 KernelBench 問題上進行評估，KernelOPT 在所有問題中相對於 \texttt{torch.compile} 實現了 1.40$\times$（級別 1：51/100）、1.15$\times$（級別 2：31/100）和 1.07$\times$（級別 3：12/50）的幾何平均加速。
